The post is shared on Instagram, as seen from the interface elements like the heart icon for liking, comment icon, share icon, and bookmark icon. The content of the post describes Sir Laurie Bristow, the UK Ambassador to Afghanistan, remaining in Kabul to process his staff's visa applications.
